About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Team

The Platform team owns everything that happens after a partner signs with Rain: implementations, account management, support, and card network operations. Account Management is responsible for growing Rain's live partners, from developers and startups to enterprise card programs, through renewals, expansions into new products and regions, and commercial conversations.

As an Associate Account Manager, you will own renewals and expansions for a set of live partners in your coverage area, and be the person they go to when something about their partnership, program setup, contract, or products needs to change. Our Implementations team launches new partners; you take over once they are live. You will start by shadowing experienced AMs on renewals and expansions, then run them with an AM alongside you, then on your own.

What you’ll do

  • Own renewals for the live partners, from the first conversation through signed paperwork

  • Find and close expansion opportunities in your accounts, such as new products (cards, virtual accounts, on/offramps, wallets, cross-border payments), additional card programs, and new regions

  • Grow net revenue retention (NRR) for your coverage area, and flag churn or contraction risk early

  • Handle partner escalations that sit outside Support: questions about the partnership, program configuration, commercial terms, and products. Bring in Product, Engineering, Finance, or Compliance when needed and follow each one through to resolution

  • Keep detailed account health and notes up to date

  • Build a health snapshot of your accounts and use it to decide where to spend your time

  • Pass partner feedback to Product to help shape the roadmap

  • Help write and improve Account Management playbooks, including expansion playbooks for new products and features

  • Learn Rain's products in depth, including stablecoin card issuing, card network basics, and our APIs

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • 0 to 3 years of experience in account management, as an account executive, or in customer success, in fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS

  • Comfort talking with partners about renewals, pricing, and commercial terms, and asking for the expansion when the opportunity is there

  • Clear written and verbal communication on calls, over email, and in shared Slack channels with partners

  • Strong organization: you can keep many accounts, deadlines, and follow-ups moving at the same time

  • Curiosity about how payments work (card issuing, authorization, settlement) and about stablecoins, and a willingness to learn technical topics, including reading API documentation

  • Ownership: when a partner raises an issue, you see it through to resolution, even when it needs help from several teams

  • Comfort working at a fast-growing company

Bonus attributes:

  • Exposure to card issuing, embedded finance, crypto, or stablecoins

  • Experience working toward a renewal, upsell, or expansion target

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The UK Financial Services sales team works with some of the largest and most important financial institutions in the UK. We help our users modernise their infrastructure, create better digital experiences for their customers, launch new products, and develop new sources of revenue.

As the banking expert within the UK Financial Services team, you will target net new enterprise business from a named account list comprising some of the UK’s largest Tier 1 banks. You will bring deep knowledge of the banking sector, help shape Stripe’s approach to the market, and navigate complex, highly regulated organisations to build relationships with senior stakeholders across business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, procurement, and finance.

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do

The UK Financial Services sales team works across the financial services sector, helping leading institutions modernise legacy infrastructure, improve customer experiences, expand their digital capabilities, and identify new opportunities for growth.

As the banking expert within the team, you will develop new relationships within a named list of Tier 1 UK banks. You will identify high value use cases for Stripe, build compelling transformation and commercial cases, and lead complex opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation and close. You will also help strengthen our understanding of the banking market and shape how Stripe positions its products and capabilities with major banks.

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Own a named account list of Tier 1 UK banks and develop detailed account plans for winning and expanding business across complex organisations
  • Act as the banking expert within the UK Financial Services team, sharing market insight and helping colleagues navigate the sector
  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial outbound engagement and use case discovery through business case development, deal structuring, negotiation, and close
  • Design and execute sales strategies suited to the extended decision making, budgeting, procurement, risk, and regulatory processes of large financial institutions
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders and senior leaders across business, technology, digital, operations, finance, risk, compliance, legal, and procurement
  • Navigate complex stakeholder ecosystems, building consensus between commercial sponsors, technical teams, control functions, and executive decision makers
  • Identify and develop new use cases for Stripe across customer propositions, digital channels, financial operations, and new business models
  • Translate banks’ strategic priorities and technical requirements into compelling, multi product solutions and clear commercial outcomes
  • Coordinate closely with Solutions Architecture, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Marketing, and other internal teams throughout the sales process
  • Lead deal strategy and commercial negotiations for large, complex, and strategically important agreements
  • Build and maintain a strong understanding of the UK banking landscape, including market dynamics, technology priorities, regulatory considerations, and competitive developments
  • Bring structured feedback from banks and prospects to Stripe’s Product and GTM teams, helping to inform our product roadmap, value proposition, and market positioning
  • Contribute to team initiatives that refine our financial services sales methodology, account planning approach, playbooks, and best practices
  • Maintain a high quality pipeline and consistently deliver against ambitious revenue targets

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic business development, or senior commercial roles
  • A track record of top performance and of securing complex, strategic enterprise agreements
  • Ability to navigate complex, highly regulated organisations and build credibility with senior stakeholders
  • Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units, functions, and executive relationships
  • Ability to understand technical and operational requirements and develop solutions across multiple products
  • Strong understanding of complex buying cycles, procurement frameworks, budgeting processes, governance requirements, and decision making structures
  • Proven ability to build consensus among diverse stakeholders, including senior executives, technology teams, business leaders, risk and compliance functions, and procurement
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial, legal, technical, and operational requirements
  • Strong business case development skills, with the ability to connect technology investments to strategic, customer, operational, and financial outcomes
  • Excellent presentation skills, particularly in executive and in person meetings involving multiple stakeholders
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in a highly ambiguous, fast paced, and cross functional environment
  • A strategic and analytical approach to developing a market, combined with the creativity and persistence required to open new opportunities
  • Strong interest in technology and its potential to transform banking and financial services

Preferred requirements

  • Experience in one or both of the following:
    • Working within a Tier 1 bank, with direct exposure to its commercial, technology, digital, or transformation priorities
    • Selling complex enterprise technology solutions into Tier 1 banks
  • An extensive network of senior relationships across the UK banking sector
  • Deep knowledge of how large banks evaluate, procure, and implement new technology
  • Familiarity with the operational, risk, compliance, legal, and procurement requirements involved in banking transformation programmes
  • A track record of closing complex, seven figure plus enterprise deals
  • Experience acting as a banking specialist or subject matter expert within a broader sales team

What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

Kalshi Inc. seeks a Software Engineer, Growth, in New York, NY to be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining user-facing systems and internal tools that enable customers to access, transact on, and manage positions within the company's online platform. Responsibilities include: build, scale, and maintain backend services and APIs that support growth, engagement, and core product functionality under production performance and reliability requirements. Own and operate notification and lifecycle engagement systems end-to-end, including service performance and scalability, notification APIs, delivery orchestration, and client-facing notification features. Design, develop, and operate data-driven systems supporting personalization, targeting, ranking, and user engagement for acquisition, activation, and retention use cases. Design and implement service APIs used by web and mobile clients and internal systems, including authentication/authorization, versioning, and backward-compatible integrations. Build and operate event-driven backend workflows using message queues or streaming platforms to process high-volume asynchronous work reliably and at scale. Support growth experimentation by implementing and integrating feature flags, A/B tests, and related instrumentation to measure and improve top-of-funnel and engagement outcomes. Collaborate with product management and frontend/mobile engineering to deliver features from concept through production release, including rollout, monitoring, and iteration. Translate ambiguous product and business requirements into technical specifications, system designs, and implementation plans for scalable, maintainable software. Work with relational and/or NoSQL datastores to model, store, and query data supporting high-volume product and engagement use cases, including schema design and query optimization. Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve production systems for latency, throughput, correctness, and operational health (logging, metrics, alerting, and incident-driven improvements).

What we’re looking for:

Must have a Bachelor’s Degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, plus 5 years of progressively, more responsible software development work experience.

In addition, the employer requires demonstrated ability in the following:

  • Demonstrated ability developing, testing, and maintaining production software using modern programming languages such as Go (Golang), JavaScript, and Python, including writing efficient, maintainable, and well-tested code gained through at least 5 years of work experience.

  • Demonstrated ability designing, developing, and documenting service APIs (REST and/or RPC), including endpoint design, authentication/authorization, versioning, and integration across client-facing and internal systems gained through at least 5 years of work experience.

  • Demonstrated ability working with both relational and NoSQL database systems, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling for high-volume applications gained through at least 5 years of work experience.

  • Demonstrated ability building, scaling, and operating high-performance backend services and distributed systems supporting high request volumes and production reliability requirements gained through at least 5 years of work experience.

  • Demonstrated ability translating ambiguous or evolving product requirements into clear technical specifications and implementation plans gained through at least 5 years of work experience.

  • Demonstrated ability implementing and supporting feature flags, A/B testing, or experimentation frameworks to evaluate product changes and drive growth or engagement metrics gained through at least 5 years of work experience.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Tokenization & Stablecoin Infrastructure team and drive the products that let institutions issue, mint, redeem, custody, and move stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets. You will work closely with stablecoin issuers, asset managers, banks, and token foundations, along with engineering, compliance, legal, and go-to-market teams, to bring new issuers and assets onto BitGo's regulated infrastructure.

This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where regulation, market structure, and technology are evolving together. You will own the roadmap, shape strategy, and see products through from first customer conversation to launch and scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own the roadmap, strategy, and execution for BitGo's tokenization and stablecoin infrastructure, including mint/burn and redemption flows, issuance workflows, reserve and settlement integrations, and tokenized asset lifecycle management.
  • Lead and motivate a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and operations and compliance partners to build institutional-grade solutions.
  • Scope and ship new issuer and asset integrations end to end: write PRDs, define order, fee, and settlement flows, align on custody and security models, and drive launch readiness.
  • Partner with stablecoin issuers, tokenized fund and asset managers, banks, and ecosystem and blockchain foundations to understand needs, shape partnerships, and turn them into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off builds.
  • Work with compliance, legal, and risk teams to make sure every product meets regulatory, security, and licensing requirements across jurisdictions.
  • Evaluate new chains, token standards, and market-structure developments (for example, tokenized securities, tokenized deposits, and onchain settlement) and turn them into a clear point of view and prioritized opportunities.
  • Define and track success metrics such as issuer onboarding time, volumes, revenue, and reliability, and iterate based on data and client feedback.
  • Work with GTM, sales, and client success teams on positioning, pricing, and client enablement, and act as a trusted product partner to key clients.
  • Mentor junior PMs and help raise the bar for product craft within the team.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, crypto, or financial infrastructure, with a record of shipping B2B or institutional products.
  • Strong working knowledge of crypto and blockchain: token standards and mechanics, multiple L1/L2 ecosystems, wallets and custody, and onchain settlement.
  • Understanding of stablecoin and tokenization models: issuance, mint/burn and redemption, reserves, fiat on/off-ramps, and how tokenized funds, securities, or deposits work.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory landscape for stablecoins and digital assets (such as GENIUS Act, MiCA, and trust-bank or custody regulation) and the ability to work through it with legal and compliance partners.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, with the ability to coordinate engineering, business, and external partners and to build consensus in ambiguous areas.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to write clear PRDs and explain complex technical or regulatory topics to executives and clients.
  • Comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, balancing several projects with different priorities and a hands-on approach to execution.
  • Prior startup or scale-up experience, showing adaptability, ownership, and sound judgment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in traditional finance, capital markets, asset management, or banking infrastructure (custody, settlement, transfer agency).
  • Hands-on exposure to institutional tokenization networks or permissioned chains.
  • Technical background or comfort reading APIs, smart contracts, and architecture docs.
  • Experience with enterprise partnerships and client-facing product work.

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of open communication, collaboration, accountability, craftsmanship, and a client first approach. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.

Here are some of the benefits of working at BitGo:

  • Competitive salary
  • IT equipment support for work
  • Meal & commute allowance
  • Medical insurance
  • Attractive well-being allowance (covering medical, wellness, and fitness)
  • Snacks on the house in the Bangalore office
  • A great, talented workforce to learn and grow with

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed finance.

Note: This role requires working onsite (Monday to Friday) at the Bangalore office.

Chainalysis Government Solutions (CGS) is a wholly-owned Chainalysis subsidiary that provides blockchain intelligence solutions, including technology, training, and services to law enforcement, defense, intelligence, and regulatory customers across the U.S. Government.

Blockchain technology is powering a growing wave of innovation. Businesses and governments around the world are using blockchains to make banking more efficient, connect with their customers, investigate criminal cases, and track transnational threats. As the adoption of blockchain technology grows, more and more organizations seek access to all this ecosystem has to offer. That's where Chainalysis comes in. We provide complete knowledge of what's happening on blockchains through our data, services, and solutions. With Chainalysis, organizations can navigate blockchains safely and with confidence.

About the Role

As a Staff Engineer, Public Sector (FedRAMP) at CGS, you will serve as the organizational subject matter expert bridging CGS and Inc engineering to operationalize, scale, and evolve our authorized FedRAMP cloud platform.

Operating with significant autonomy, you will lead the technical ownership, architecture, and continuous delivery of our public sector cloud boundary as US Government customers onboard and additional product lines expand into FedRAMP. In This Role, You’ll:

  • Mentor & Guide Technical Teams: Provide high-level guidance, architecture reviews, and coaching to peer engineers across both entities, driving best practices for public sector and government cloud architectures across the organization.

We’re Looking for Candidates Who Have:

  • Experience & Scope: 8+ years of software, DevOps, cloud, or systems engineering experience, with significant experience designing, deploying, and sustaining platforms within authorized FedRAMP (Moderate or High) environments.

  • Leadership & Autonomy: Proven track record operating with high autonomy as a Staff-level technical lead—taking high-level strategic product and architectural goals and translating them into robust engineering solutions with minimal oversight.

  • Containers & Orchestration: Strong experience building and maintaining containerized applications using Kubernetes, Docker, or Amazon EKS.

  • Security & Compliance Acumen: Deep working knowledge of FedRAMP authorization lifecycles, NIST SP 800-53 controls, vulnerability remediation, and continuous monitoring (ConMon) workflows.

  • Modern Languages & Automation: Proficiency with scripting and software development languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash) to build automation, tooling, and integrations.

  • Influence & Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate highly complex architecture and compliance nuances clearly across executive stakeholders, product teams, and technical engineers.

  • Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required.

Stands Out:

  • Direct experience taking a SaaS platform through initial FedRAMP In-Process to Authorized status (Agency or JAB/FedRAMP Marketplace).

  • Prior experience working within hybrid or cross-entity engineering organizations bridging commercial and public sector subsidiaries.

  • Hands-on experience with modern data/analytics platforms or blockchain data structures.

  • Familiarity with DoD Impact Levels (IL4/IL5) or commercial cloud environments integrated with federal systems.

Flow Traders runs on data. Trading, research, finance, and operations all depend on reliable numbers and a clear understanding of what those numbers mean. Today, business teams bring questions and project ideas to our BI and FP&A specialists, but there is a gap between business intent and the specific, measurable requirements needed to deliver effective solutions. This can result in projects starting without a clear definition of ROI and KPIs lacking clear business ownership.

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will bridge this gap by translating business needs into actionable requirements, challenging business cases before they become projects, and establishing clear KPI definitions and ownership. You will work closely with business stakeholders, project management, BI, and FP&A to ensure initiatives are properly defined, prioritized, and measured against their expected returns.

This is an advisory role where you will act as an internal consultant, expected to form independent views, challenge weak reasoning, and drive decisions with senior stakeholders. Rather than building pipelines or dashboards yourself, you will focus on the frameworks, requirements, and processes that enable analytics and data engineers to deliver effective solutions. Your work will help establish accountability for business metrics, improve project prioritization, and ensure technical teams can focus on delivery rather than requirements discovery.

What you will do

  • Translate business intent into requirements. Work with business teams to understand the decisions behind their requests and translate ambiguous questions into clear, testable requirements that analytics and data engineers can build from independently.
  • Prioritize business requests. Evaluate incoming requests based on their expected value and required effort, challenging or rejecting initiatives that lack sufficient justification.
  • Define and track project ROI. Collaborate with project management to establish expected returns and measurement frameworks before projects begin. Challenge business cases with unclear, unattributable, or overlapping benefits and track realized versus projected outcomes after delivery.
  • Establish KPI definitions and ownership. Facilitate discussions with business stakeholders to define metrics, their underlying data, and the decisions they support. Secure formal sign-off from named business owners and conduct recurring reviews to keep definitions relevant.
  • Drive alignment across departments. Resolve conflicting metric definitions between business teams, establish consistency, and escalate disagreements where alignment cannot be reached.
  • Bridge business, BI, and FP&A. Act as the central point of translation between departmental business questions and reporting requirements, ensuring stakeholders understand the origins and meaning of their data.
  • Improve reporting effectiveness. Identify and consolidate reporting that no longer supports business decisions, reducing unnecessary complexity and improving efficiency.

What you need to succeed

Required

  • Substantial experience as a business analyst in a data- or reporting-heavy environment, with a proven track record of owning business requirements.
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear, actionable technical specifications.
  • Experience developing business cases, defining expected ROI, establishing measurement frameworks, and evaluating realized benefits.
  • Proven ability to define KPIs with business stakeholders, establish clear ownership, and ensure accountability for agreed metrics.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, defend recommendations, and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Ability to operate independently in an advisory capacity, bringing structure to complex business questions and facilitating decisions with senior stakeholders.

Strongly preferred

  • Experience in financial services, trading, or another regulated environment.
  • Working familiarity with a modern data stack such as SQL or Power BI, sufficient to collaborate effectively with technical teams without directly building solutions.
  • Exposure to data governance or data quality practices.

From a thorough onboarding and ongoing access to Flow Academy, to latest technology and a collaborative, non‑hierarchical culture, we give you the tools, ownership, and support to move fast and drive outcomes. We keep a close‑knit, small‑company feel while offering competitive salary, annual discretionary profit share, and comprehensive benefits, so talent can grow here, and stay here. About Telcoin Digital Asset Bank
Telcoin Digital Asset Bank (TDAB) is a Nebraska-chartered digital asset depository institution that brings regulated banking and blockchain-based financial services together, including digital asset custody, stablecoin issuance and redemption, and on-chain payments. As we build out the Bank’s operations, we are looking for an experienced compliance leader to establish and scale a strong, risk-based financial crimes compliance program.

The Role
We are looking for a Chief Compliance Officer who will also serve as the Board-designated BSA Officer. The successful candidate will own the Bank’s BSA/AML, counter-terrorist financing and OFAC sanctions compliance program across both fiat and digital asset activity.

This senior leadership role reports to the Board Risk/Audit Committee. It is the Bank’s primary BSA/AML contact for the state banking regulator, FinCEN, OFAC and federal partners.

Key Responsibilities

Program ownership and governance

  • Update, implement, and maintain a risk-based BSA/AML/CFT and OFAC program covering the five pillars: internal controls, independent testing, a designated BSA Officer, training, and customer due diligence including beneficial ownership.
  • Draft and annually refresh BSA/AML and sanctions policies, procedures, and the Board-approved risk appetite.
  • Report program status, metrics, and material issues to the Board and senior management at least quarterly.
  • Own the enterprise BSA/AML and sanctions risk assessment, including products, customers, geographies, delivery channels, and digital asset types.

Customer due diligence

  • Oversee CIP, KYC, KYB, and enhanced due diligence for retail, institutional, and VASP/counterparty customers.
  • Set customer risk-rating methodology and periodic review cycles.
  • Approve onboarding of high-risk customers, including other virtual asset service providers, money services businesses, and foreign correspondents.

Transaction monitoring and blockchain analytics

  • Oversee fiat and on-chain transaction monitoring, including blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, Sumsub) for wallet screening, exposure analysis, and tracing.
  • Tune scenarios and thresholds; document model validation and above/below-the-line testing.
  • Address digital-asset typologies: mixers and privacy tools, darknet markets, ransomware, chain-hopping, bridge exploits, and sanctioned addresses.

Travel Rule and sanctions

  • Implement FinCEN Recordkeeping and Travel Rule compliance and FATF Recommendation 16 for virtual asset transfers, including counterparty VASP due diligence.
  • Run OFAC and global sanctions screening of customers, transactions, and wallet addresses (including SDN-listed addresses); manage blocking, rejection, and reporting obligations.

Investigations and regulatory reporting

  • Manage alert and case investigations; make final SAR filing decisions and ensure timely filing and continuing-activity reviews.
  • Ensure accurate and timely CTRs, 314(a) responses, 314(b) information sharing, and responses to subpoenas and law enforcement requests.

Stablecoin and custody controls

  • Establish AML controls for stablecoin issuance, redemption, reserves-related flows, and freeze/blacklist capabilities in coordination with Legal and Engineering.
  • Ensure custody and wallet-management processes meet recordkeeping and monitoring requirements.

Exams, audits, and training

  • Serve as primary contact for BSA/AML portions of regulatory examinations and independent audits; own remediation of findings.
  • Deliver role-based BSA/AML training for the Board, employees, and contractors, with tailored digital asset content.

Team leadership and scaling

  • Build, staff, and lead the financial crimes compliance team; set QA standards and KPIs.
  • Design a compliance operating model that grows with the business, and plan staffing, tooling, and process needs ahead of growth in customers, transaction volumes, products, and jurisdictions.
  • Develop talent through clear career paths, succession planning and ongoing professional development.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed compliance controls into new products before launch.

If you are an experienced BSA/AML leader who wants to build a compliance program for the next generation of banking, we would be pleased to hear from you.

About the role

You'll work with our social media manager on video content across Fasset's and the CEO Office's social media platforms. Each week, you'll brainstorm creatives and content ideas together for both the brand and personal channels. You'll get the creative freedom to explore new formats and styles. This is a role for someone who loves to experiment. Bring your boldest ideas to the table and we’ll give you the room to bring them to life.

Key responsibilities

  • Bring ideas to weekly brainstorming meetings with the social media manager for brand and personal channels.
  • Develop concepts and draft storyboards for short-form, long-form and campaign content.
  • Plan and run shoots, handling filming, lighting and audio, in the office and outdoors.
  • Film founder-led content with the CEO for the CEO Office’s personal channels.
  • Edit videos end to end, from raw reactive clips to polished, high-production pieces, including subtitles, music and sound design.
  • Design supporting visuals such as thumbnails and cover frames.
  • Turn around ad-hoc and reactive content quickly when trends or news break.
  • Keep all content on-brand and maintain an organized footage and asset library.
  • Review video performance with the social media manager and use the insights to shape the next round of content.
  • Experiment with new formats, styles, hooks and lengths to find what drives growth.
